jobs.description:
Your team

The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk, and Taxation.

Group Finance is dedicated to ensuring robust financial management and reporting, supporting the Group’s strategic objectives through effective financial operations, strong internal controls, and compliance with regulatory requirements.

As a member of the Group Finance community, the Senior Finance Manager will join the Accounting, Data & Reporting team, reporting to the Head of Financial Reporting and Regulatory Reporting Solutions. The role will involve close collaboration with all members of the Accounting, Data & Reporting team, as well as with other internal teams, to ensure the effective management of financial operations and reporting.

Your role

As a Senior Finance Manager, you will play a key role in overseeing and executing core financial processes within the Group Finance function. You will leverage your strong finance expertise and understanding of the banking industry to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial data and reporting.

You will be responsible for the following tasks:

• Participate in finance-related projects, including process improvements, system enhancements, and implementation of new regulatory requirements.
• Oversee daily financial operations, including data maintenance, reconciliations, and operational controls to ensure accuracy and compliance.
• Contribute to the preparation and delivery of financial, regulatory and management reports, ensuring consistency with both regulatory standards and internal policies.
• Collaborate closely with all members of the Accounting, Data & Reporting team and other internal stakeholders, including Finance, Risk, and IT teams, to gather requirements, resolve issues, and drive process optimization.
• Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, responding to queries, and implementing recommendations.
• Maintain the Internal Control System (ICS), to ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulations.
• Contribute to the development and documentation of finance processes and procedures.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in Finance or equivalent.
• At least ten years’ experience in the banking industry within a Finance department and/or in external audit.
• Strong knowledge of financial reporting, accounting principles, and regulatory requirements in the banking sector.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights.
• Proven experience in managing financial operations, controls, and reporting processes.
• Strong proactivity, adaptability, autonomy, curiosity, and a can-do attitude.
• Excellent collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and functional stakeholders.
• Fluent in French and English.
• Must be a resident in Switzerland.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref. : SFM/CC/SM

Personalizzato da specialisti con profonda competenza in tutte le linee aziendali, le funzioni centrali sono organizzate in vari dipartimenti di gruppo: Comunicazione, conformità, finanza, risorse umane, sicurezza dell'informazione, controllo interno, legale, ufficio aziendale, rischio e tassazione. Group Finance è dedicata a garantire una solida gestione finanziaria e reporting, supportando gli obiettivi strategici del Gruppo attraverso operazioni finanziarie efficaci, controlli interni forti e il rispetto dei requisiti normativi. Come membro della comunità delle Finanze del Gruppo, il Senior Finance Manager si unirà al team di Contabilità, Data & Reporting, segnalando al responsabile del reporting finanziario e delle soluzioni di reporting regolamentare. Il ruolo coinvolgerà una stretta collaborazione con tutti i membri del team Accounting, Data & Reporting, così come con altri team interni, per garantire l'efficace gestione delle operazioni finanziarie e reporting. Il tuo ruolo In qualità di Senior Finance Manager, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella supervisione e nell'esecuzione dei processi finanziari fondamentali all'interno della funzione Finanza di Gruppo. Potrai sfruttare la tua forte competenza finanziaria e la comprensione del settore bancario per garantire l'accuratezza, l'integrità e la tempestività dei dati finanziari e la reportistica. Sarete responsabili dei seguenti compiti:
• Partecipare a progetti relativi alla finanza, compresi i miglioramenti dei processi, i miglioramenti del sistema e l'attuazione di nuovi requisiti normativi.
• supervisionare le operazioni finanziarie quotidiane, compresa la manutenzione dei dati, la riconciliazione e i controlli operativi per garantire l'accuratezza e la conformità.
• Contribuire alla preparazione e alla consegna delle relazioni finanziarie, regolamentari e gestionali, garantendo coerenza con gli standard normativi e le politiche interne.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con tutti i membri del team Accounting, Data & Reporting e altri stakeholder interni, inclusi i team Finance, Risk e IT, per raccogliere i requisiti, risolvere i problemi e guidare l'ottimizzazione dei processi.
• Sostenere gli audit interni ed esterni preparando la documentazione, rispondendo alle domande e alle raccomandazioni di attuazione.
• Mantenere il sistema di controllo interno (ICS), per garantire l'adesione alle politiche interne e alle normative esterne.
• Contribuire allo sviluppo e alla documentazione dei processi e delle procedure finanziarie. Il tuo profilo
• Laurea magistrale in Finanza o equivalente.
• Almeno dieci anni di esperienza nel settore bancario all’interno di un dipartimento di finanza e/o di audit esterno.
• Forte conoscenza della rendicontazione finanziaria, dei principi contabili e dei requisiti normativi nel settore bancario.
• Eccellente capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con la capacità di interpretare i dati finanziari complessi e fornire insight attuabili.
• Provata esperienza nella gestione delle operazioni finanziarie, dei controlli e dei processi di reporting.
• Forte proattività, adattabilità, autonomia, curiosità e un atteggiamento in grado di fare.
• Eccellente capacità di collaborazione, con la capacità di lavorare in modo efficace con gli stakeholder tecnici e funzionali.
• Fluente in francese e inglese.

Ihr Team Der Geschäftsbereich Corporate Functions umfasst die Nicht-Banking-Aktivitäten des Konzerns und umfasst über 600 Mitarbeiter. Die zentralen Funktionen werden von Spezialisten mit fundierter Expertise in allen Geschäftsbereichen in verschiedene Gruppenabteilungen organisiert: Kommunikation, Compliance, Finanzen, Humanressourcen, Informationssicherheit, Interne Audit, Recht, Corporate Office, Risiko und Steuern. Die Group Finance ist darauf ausgerichtet, ein robustes Finanzmanagement und eine solide Berichterstattung zu gewährleisten, die strategischen Ziele der Gruppe durch effektive Finanzoperationen, starke interne Kontrollen und die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen zu unterstützen. Als Mitglied der Group Finance Community wird der Senior Finance Manager dem Team Accounting, Data & Reporting beitreten und dem Leiter Financial Reporting und Regulatory Reporting Solutions melden. Die Rolle wird eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit allen Mitgliedern des Teams Accounting, Data & Reporting sowie mit anderen internen Teams beinhalten, um die effektive Verwaltung von Finanzgeschäften und Berichterstattung zu gewährleisten. Ihre Rolle Als Senior Finance Manager spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Überwachung und Durchführung von Kernfinanzprozessen innerhalb der Group Finance Funktion. Sie nutzen Ihre starke Finanzexpertise und das Verständnis der Bankenbranche, um die Richtigkeit, Integrität und Aktualität von Finanzdaten und Berichterstattung zu gewährleisten. Sie sind für folgende Aufgaben verantwortlich:
• Beteiligung an finanzbezogenen Projekten, einschließlich Prozessverbesserungen, Systemverbesserungen und Umsetzung neuer regulatorischer Anforderungen.
• Überwachung der täglichen Finanzoperationen, einschließlich der Datenwartung, der Aussöhnung und der operativen Kontrollen, um die Genauigkeit und Compliance zu gewährleisten.
• Beitrag zur Erstellung und Lieferung von Finanz-, Regulierungs- und Managementberichten, um die Übereinstimmung mit den Regulierungsstandards und den internen Politiken zu gewährleisten.
• Zusammenarbeit mit allen Mitgliedern des Teams Accounting, Data & Reporting und anderen internen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Finanzen, Risiko und IT-Teams, um Anforderungen zu sammeln, Probleme zu lösen und Prozessoptimierung zu betreiben.
• Unterstützung interner und externer Audits durch Erstellung von Dokumentationen, Beantwortung von Abfragen und Umsetzungsempfehlungen.
• Das interne Kontrollsystem (ICS) aufrechtzuerhalten, um die Einhaltung interner Richtlinien und externer Vorschriften sicherzustellen.
• Beitrag zur Entwicklung und Dokumentation von Finanzprozessen und -verfahren. Ihr Profil
• Masterstudium in Finanzen oder gleichwertig.
• mindestens zehn Jahre Erfahrung in der Bankenbranche innerhalb einer Finanzabteilung und/oder im externen Audit.
• Starkes Wissen über Finanzberichterstattung, Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze und regulatorische Anforderungen im Bankensektor.
• Ausgezeichnete analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Finanzdaten zu interpretieren und hilfreiche Einblicke zu geben.
• Erfahrungen bei der Verwaltung von Finanzgeschäften, Kontrollen und Berichterstattungsprozessen.
• Starke Proaktivität, Anpassungsfähigkeit, Autonomie, Neugier und eine Can-do Haltung.
• Ausgezeichnete Zusammenarbeitsfähigkeit, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit technischen und funktionalen Akteuren zu arbeiten.

Group Finance s'engage à assurer une gestion financière et des rapports solides, à appuyer les objectifs stratégiques du Groupe par des opérations financières efficaces, des contrôles internes solides et le respect des exigences réglementaires. En tant que membre de la communauté des finances de groupe, le gestionnaire principal des finances se joindra à l'équipe de comptabilité, de données et de rapports, qui relèvera du chef des Solutions de rapports financiers et de rapports réglementaires. Le rôle consistera à collaborer étroitement avec tous les membres de l'équipe de la comptabilité, des données et des rapports, ainsi qu'avec d'autres équipes internes, afin d'assurer une gestion efficace des opérations et des rapports financiers. Vous tirerez parti de votre solide expertise financière et de votre compréhension du secteur bancaire pour assurer l'exactitude, l'intégrité et la rapidité des données financières et des rapports. Vous serez responsable des tâches suivantes:
• Participer à des projets liés au financement, y compris l'amélioration des processus, l'amélioration des systèmes et la mise en oeuvre de nouvelles exigences réglementaires.
• Surveiller les opérations financières quotidiennes, y compris la maintenance des données, les rapprochements et les contrôles opérationnels pour assurer l'exactitude et la conformité.
• Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la prestation de rapports financiers, réglementaires et de gestion, en veillant à la cohérence avec les normes réglementaires et les politiques internes.
• Collaborer étroitement avec tous les membres de l'équipe Comptabilité, données et rapports et d'autres intervenants internes, y compris les équipes Finances, Risques et IT, pour recueillir les exigences, résoudre les problèmes et piloter l'optimisation des processus.

• Mettre à jour le Système de contrôle interne (SCI) pour assurer le respect des politiques internes et des règlements externes.
• Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la documentation des processus et procédures financiers. Votre profil
• Maîtrise en finance ou équivalent.
• Au moins dix ans d'expérience dans le secteur bancaire au sein d'un département des finances et/ou en audit externe.
• Bonne connaissance de l'information financière, des principes comptables et des exigences réglementaires dans le secteur bancaire.
• Excellente capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité d'interpréter des données financières complexes et de fournir des informations pratiques.
• Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion des opérations financières, des contrôles et des processus d'établissement de rapports.
• Proactivité forte, adaptabilité, autonomie, curiosité et attitude de candeur.
• Excellentes compétences en collaboration, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement avec les acteurs techniques et fonctionnels.
• En français et en anglais.

Pictet Asset Services (PAS) provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund
managers and institutional clients.We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain, and our range of bespoke
solutions includes value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide
an unrivalled client experience.

Your role

• Managing a team that serves as the main point of contact between the Bank's operational centres of expertise and
third-party managers (“EAMs”) (monitoring the activity of group members, handling and resolving escalated issues, setting
and monitoring objectives, assessing performance, drawing up training plans).

business.

• Assessing non-standardised client requests compared with PAS's usual service offering.
• Being involved in the process of setting up EAM relationships and their client accounts, in collaboration with the
relationship managers (CRM).
• Providing operational nursing services to EAM.
• Providing targeted operational services.
• Providing administrative and technical assistance to EAMs.

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centers worldwide, currently employing more than 5’000 people. Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

You will assist our Quality Control & Mobile team for the fund operations processes :

• Providing support operational teams in their daily tasks,

• Identifying areas of improvement in terms of the process and control framework,

• Contributing to the implementation of key quality control deliverables such as KPIs and the procedure framework review,

• Contributing to any other transversal project aimed at improving service delivery.

Your profile

Qualifications and experience:

• Pursuing a university degree in Finance, Economics or a related field.

Specific knowledge:

• Knowledge in fund operations,

• Experience in process and data analysis,

• Project management and organizational skills,

• Good Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• Spoken fluency in English and French.

• Flexibility and agility,

jobs.title: Banking Operations Officer (Fixed-term 12 months)
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

The scope of the function is to oversee all the workflow from the trade reception, data analysis and life cycle data management to instruments pricing. The scope of asset includes listed products (equities, bonds, loan, derivatives), OTC products (IRS,CDS, FX & Equity options, TRS, CFD…) and Structured products (autocall, Reverse convertible, dual currency deposit, accumulator, Airbag…).

• Integration and control of assets opening in our global platform Neoxam.

• Control and publish prices, greeks, market data and analytics.

• Life cycle management of all Assets.

• Set up the necessary files to complement these feeds.

• Introduce the necessary settings for queries and Data/pricing flows for securities newly registered in our systems from our various financial information providers (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters and ICE).

• Regularly check and update these settings.

• Provide the assistance requested by the various users of these Data (accountants for investment funds, valuers, administrators, asset managers, wealth managers, etc.).

• Challenge of various assets type with the counterparty's prices.

• Liaise directly with our main stakeholders in case of issue.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Master’s degree in Finance, economics.

• 2 to 5 years’ experience minimum in a similar position.

Knowledge / technical skills:

• Good knowledge of financial products and good level in financial mathematic.

• Good knowledge of financial information providers.

• Skilled user of office software applications, especially Excel.

Soft skills:

• Driven and capable of showing initiative in solving problems.

• An enquiring mind with strong learning skills and a well-developed critical faculty.

• Accuracy and thoroughness in searching for the information required to value securities.

• Good capacity to collaborate and find win-win solution.

Language skills:

• French: fluent level

• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

The Role is to provide 1st level support on Fund Admnistration activities. To centralise, coordinate, and respond to Clients, Business Lines & Auditors requests and contribute to improvements of the processes, procedures and operational platforms to guarantee the proper application of controls and consistently exceed client’s needs and expectations.

Your role

• Collaborate with Business Implementation Team, Client Relationship Managers (CRM), Management Companies and other key stakeholders (Custody Bank, Pricing, Transfer Agent (TA)…) on Projects & fund-related events.

• Act as the main liaison for both external and internal Clients, as well as Auditors, regarding all Fund Administration day-to-day activities.

• Manage the end-to-end Audit process for the funds, from initial planning & timetable, preparation and coordination of the financial statements to final approval and CSSF filling. Respond to Audit queries and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions and / or process improvement & automation as needed.

• Support Fund Administration Operations teams and effectively manage relationships across various business lines, including CRM, Business Implementation Team, TA , Tax, and others.

• Demonstrate a proactive mindset in addressing fund-related issues, actively challenge the status quo, and contribute innovative ideas for process enhancement.

• Participate in due diligence meetings, service reviews, Client visits, and Board meetings as required.

• Monitor internal and external KPIs and take actions when needed

• Manage and resolve internal and external escalations, taking appropriate actions and escalating to management when necessary.

• Assist in the review of Operating Memorandum, Service Level Agreements, Prospectus, internal policies, procedures working instructions & check-list, RCSA Matrix and any other related documentation.

• Remain up to date with all internal policies and ensure strict adherence to legal and regulatory requirements.

• Act as back-up of Head of Client Services and participate in the Management Committee of the Funds Accounting Unit when required

Your profile

• Strong knowledge of financial products and funds regulation.

• Master's degree in Economics or Finance

• Min 10 years experience in Accounting

• Fluent in French and English

• In-depth understanding of Fund Administration and the relationships with the different stakeholders

• Experience in NAV calculations and NAV production

• Strong experience in financial reporting and audit process

• Good knowledge in foreign currency hedging and asset pooling techniques.

• Experience in fund events (merger, CIK/RIK, fund restructuring, etc.).

• Knowledge of Multifonds.

• Good knowledge in MS Office tool (mainly Excel).

• Flexibility - Can-do attitude

• Client oriented mindset.

• Sense of initiative and willing to learn.

• Strong analytical skills.

• Strong communication & presentation skills

• Rigorous and organized.

• Manage Stress and prioritization.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
